name: Pranav Jagtap
tagline: I build scalable backend systems and GenAI applications.
availability: Open to interesting problems in distributed systems, databases & AI.
intro: I'm a Full-Stack AI Engineer with 3+ years of experience delivering scalable backend systems and GenAI applications using .NET Core, FastAPI, and LLM integrations. I've owned features end-to-end, from prototype to production, across microservices architecture and multi-region platform design.

Currently at Avalpha Technologies, I architect monolith & microservices-based backends, ship AI-powered product features, and collaborate directly with the CTO on architectural decisions at a startup scale. Before that, I spent two years at Prismatic Softwares building industrial software across manufacturing, healthcare, and construction domains.

I care about process optimization, clean architecture, and squeezing performance out of the systems I build. When I'm not shipping, I'm usually exploring something new, which is exactly what The Lab below keeps track of.
